installAgentPrompt: Saita HAX (https://haxtheweb.org) a wannan kwamfuta. Shigar da HAX CLI da `npm install @haxtheweb/create --global`, sannan ka shigar da ƙwarewar wakilinsa da `hax skills install --all`. Yi shafi da `hax site my-hax-site --y --no-i`, fara shi da `cd my-hax-site && hax serve`, kuma ka faɗa min adireshin da ya buga. Karanta AGENTS.md na shafin da https://github.com/haxtheweb/praw kafin ka canza komai.
